final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each person feedback.

- **Dora:** Her site is clean and simple, and her contact email is easy to find. I suggested adding a short bio, her projects or interests, and some visuals. I invited her to Slack using the email on her site (dora@gmail.com) before messaging her. The invite tool returned no confirmation, so I can't confirm she has joined. The message was sent without an error.
- **Eve:** Her blog has a personal feel and shows her love of hiking. I suggested adding more posts, such as trail stories with photos, and a short About section.
